final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: a staff engineer finds useful work by absorbing real problems, letting them accumulate, finding a common shape, and pressure-testing before investing. The reader should quickly feel that scattered requests converge into one verified shared need. Summary angle: turn unrelated requests into one common shape, then pass it through a validation gate. Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and four supporting narrative beats. Information blocks: listen to daily difficulties, let signals accumulate, discover the common shape behind Perfetto UI requests, then validate before building. Main metaphor: threads of scattered notes weave into one luminous shape that passes through a gate. Subject: central glowing common shape formed by converging thread-like signal lines, with four small labeled points at the edges. Composition/framing: single-point radial convergence, one strong focal subject, legible in a wide cover. Style/medium: combine conceptual editorial illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: suspense thriller comic mood, low-key lighting, sharp shadows, uneasy framing, controlled tension without gore. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: off-white, deep ink blue, warm orange, moss green. Visible text policy: allow only four short simplified Chinese label chips: 倾听, 积累, 找共性, 先验证. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid: real product screenshots, dashboard style, stacked chips, speech bubbles, blood red, grotesque figures, text poster, English long labels, code rain, watermarks.
